name: Erwin Rommel
source: German general and military theorist. Popularly known as the Desert Fox, he served in the Wehrmacht before being called back to Berlin during Stauffenberg's coup, after which he became the most powerful man in Germany, as the entirety of the German high command is turned into anime girls. He serves as the unofficial head of the German government in order to prevent the Anime-Führer from destroying Germany.
